name.en: われは海の子 (Ware wa Umi no Ko)

licence.attribution: われは海の子 (Ware wa Umi no Ko). Words: 作詞者不詳; disputed between 宮原晃一郎 (1945) and 芳賀矢一 (1927). Music: 不詳. First published 1910, 尋常小学読本唱歌. Public domain in Japan and the United States.

japan.basis: lyricist 作詞者不詳; disputed between 宮原晃一郎 (1945) and 芳賀矢一 (1927); composer 不詳. The later of the two deaths is 1945.
japan.test: Japan: both authors died 1967 or earlier, or the work is anonymous and published 1967 or earlier.

us.basis: first published 1910, 尋常小学読本唱歌.
us.test: US: published 1930 or earlier, or published later with every author dead in 1945 or earlier, because the URAA restored anything still protected in its source country on 1996-01-01.

_licence.confidence_text: High. Every candidate author died 1945 or earlier, so the dispute does not change the verdict.
_licence.verses_permitted_note: Three. Verses 6 and 7 are public domain but are wartime copy dropped from postwar textbooks, and the report says to ship verses 1 to 3 only. The report's section E heading promises verses 1 to 3 and then prints only the first, so this file carries one verse: the other two are unbuilt, not omitted on purpose.
_licence.note: Derived from data/songs/ware-wa-umi-no-ko.json: one item per line, the pieces cut on the word boundaries of the corpus's romaji line aligned onto the kana (a one-kana piece joins the piece before it, a repeated piece is one piece), the verse gloss shown after a miss. Verdicts, credits and the authors' death years are copied from that file. Qualifier: verses 1 to 3.

items.line: われは うみのこ しらなみの

gloss.en: I am a child of the sea: that thatched hut with smoke trailing, in the pine grove on the loud white-capped shore, is my dear old home.
gloss.es: Soy hijo del mar: esa choza de paja con el humo que se alarga, en el pinar de la orilla ruidosa de espuma blanca, es mi querido hogar de siempre.
